description: This file defines the CodeFormater class, a helper utility for formatting code or data into tabular form, with methods for populating rows and columns, and outputting formatted buffers.

classes.name: CodeFormater
classes.description: A utility class for creating and printing tabular formatted code or data, supporting multiple rows and columns, with filler rows and padding.

methods.name: CodeFormater
methods.description: Constructor initializing the formatter with a specified number of columns.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in a specific column of the current row, updating maximum column width.

methods.name: nextRow
methods.description: Advances to the next row, adding a new row to the internal list.

methods.name: appendFillerRow
methods.description: Adds a filler row with specified line content.

methods.name: printBuffer
methods.description: Outputs the formatted table to a PrintWriter with specified padding.

methods.name: toStringBuffer
methods.description: Returns a StringBuffer containing the formatted table with padding.
